basic_details.job_title: PAU Junior Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has officially announced the Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening under Advertisement No. 23.07.2026/1724-1823. Candidates aged 18 to 63 years who have passed Matric with Punjabi are eligible to submit their offline applications on or before 07-08-2026. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 24-08-2026. Direct links to download the official notification and application form are shared below.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 63 years

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post at PAU?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper position at Punjab Agricultural University is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper position, candidates must have passed their Matriculation examination and possess knowledge of Punjabi language.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The age criteria for this recruitment range from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 63 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post involves candidates appearing before a Selection Committee. This committee will assess the suitability of the applicants for the role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Jr. Field / Lab Helper post will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 13486 to Rs. 14286 per month, along with an additional Rs. 800 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for the PAU Jr. Field / Lab Helper recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 100/-. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is 23.07.2026/1724-1823. This number should be referenced in all correspondence related to the application.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: Punjab Agricultural University has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Jr. Field / Lab Helper in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, which is pau.edu. Links are also provided in the Important Links section of this article.
